name: NUS High School of Math and Science
summary: Specialised independent school for mathematically and scientifically gifted students.
body: NUS High is a specialised pathway for students with exceptional STEM aptitude. Admissions are selective and aptitude-based. Relevant as landscape knowledge for families whose children may qualify — not a general international alternative. Ask how lost-property windows and parent-portal permission slips are communicated to dual-career households — notification lead times matter more than brochure tours. STEM-heavy calendars still collide with climbing-gym waits — dual-career households should separate viewing-bench hellos from CAS evidence nights.
waitlistNotes: Selection tests and interviews — prepare early.
